bounded_failures: Hugging Face snapshot API returned HTTP 429 before any model byte was downloaded; direct immutable-revision URLs were the single download repair.

The first generated cache used tokenizer-internal word_ids and scoring rejected an out-of-range official-token index before results; the single implementation repair rebuilt maps from exact character offsets. The rejected cache was never scored.
Regenerated M0 did not match published rounded B4 scores exactly (mean absolute difference 0.001527; maximum 0.130091), so direct published-B4 comparability is explicitly limited.
